name: Control Rod Position Disagreement
description: The rod position indication for the controlling bank diverges from demand. A rod-position channel reads a stuck value while the bank actually moves, producing a rod deviation alarm and a mismatch between indicated reactivity and observed power.
briefing: At t+20 s a rod-position channel sticks. Shortly after, automatic rod control makes a small correction. Use neutron power and T-avg to judge the true rod position.
learning_objectives: Cross-checking rod position against core power and temperature
Position indication is itself an instrument that can fail
Distinguishing a stuck rod (process) from a stuck rod indicator (instrument)

events.label: Slow positive reactivity (e.g. boron dilution) forcing a rod correction
